name: @comchatx/cx-amazon-finance-playbook
description: Ties out your Amazon payouts, and each product's profit.
author: ComChatX

comchatx.name: Amazon Finance Playbook
comchatx.about: 对上亚马逊每期结算和回款，算出每个商品的利润。

money-flow.zh: 查清钱在哪：递延、预留、可用，何时回款。
money-flow.en: Where your money is, and when the next payout goes.

fees-and-charges.zh: 说清亚马逊每种费用怎么算、何时扣。
fees-and-charges.en: Each Amazon fee: how it is worked out, when it posts.

refunds-and-reimbursements.zh: 分析退款、索赔和赔偿对回款的影响。
refunds-and-reimbursements.en: What refunds, claims and reimbursements do to your money.

product-earnings.zh: 算出每个商品扣掉费用和成本后的利润。
product-earnings.en: What each product earns after fees and costs.

settlement-reconcile.zh: 把结算和回款、账本对上，说清差额。
settlement-reconcile.en: Settlements matched to payouts and your books.

tax-lines.zh: 分清每笔钱里的税，以及由谁缴。
tax-lines.en: The tax in each money line, and who pays it.

money-reads.zh: 说明每项财务数据从哪读、多久更新。
money-reads.en: Where each money figure is read, and how late it lands.

money-where.zh: 看看亚马逊的钱在哪，下一笔回款哪天发出。

fees-review.zh: 查看上个月亚马逊扣的费用、算法和变化。

product-earnings.zh: 算出上个月每个商品扣掉费用和成本后赚了多少。

settlement-check.zh: 把最近一期结算和回款对上，说清每笔差额。

refunds-review.zh: 查看上个月的退款、赔偿和调整，各对应哪个订单或货件。
